name: camera/dolly-zoom
title: Dolly Zoom (Vertigo Shot)
desc_vi: Máy quay tiến hoặc lùi trong khi góc nhìn đổi ngược lại, chủ thể giữ nguyên cỡ còn hậu cảnh co rút hoặc ùa tới.
params_vi: direction: Dolly direction (out | in), mặc định "out" · strength: Move strength (end / start distance ratio), mặc định 2 · subjectDistance: Camera-to-subject distance at the start of the move, mặc định 1400 · easing: Dolly easing (none | sine.inOut | power1.inOut | power2.inOut | power3.inOut), mặc định "power2.inOut" · duration: độ dài của block (4 s) · replace: các cặp [chữ gốc, chữ mới] đổi nội dung trước khi chạy (ví dụ tiếng Việt)
notes: Run as shipped: the block's own page (assets/camera-dolly-zoom.html) in an iframe, its timeline set from the film's time. Fonts: Google / fontsource families are drawn with the kit's RFlex / RMono.  Source: Camera tracks toward or away from the subject while the field of view changes the opposite way, so the subject holds its frame size while the background collapses behind it or rushes in. Focal length is solved from dolly distance every frame against d * tan(FOV/2) = const, not keyframed beside it. Requires depth: the subject sits on the z = 0 plane and the content behind it must be layered or genuinely 3D (translateZ at two or more distinct depths) -- a flat element gains nothing from this move.
